note:
account_account_tag._translate_tax_tags built its lang parameter as SQL("'%s'" % lang) -- a raw interpolation into the query text.

It is now SQL("%s::text", lang), a bound parameter. The cast is load-bearing: psycopg 3 binds server-side, so jsonb_build_object($1, ...) cannot infer the type and the query dies IndeterminateDatatype without it. Caught by installing account, not by any linter.

17 -> 16. Measured at the CI scope this suite defines: addons-path odoo/addons,addons, -i test_lint alone.

Command: odoo-bin -d <db> -i test_lint --test-enable --test-tags /test_lint
